name: Iinari ♀♂ Otoko no Ko
source:
It was hours after school ended, but peeping in on the classroom I saw Natsuki Aida was still around, wearing girl's clothes, masturbating. Was this my chance to screw him (over)?
I took a picture of him for safekeeping. This would be what I use to make Natsuki my "slave"... 

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE141002.html]DLsite English[/url]]
